"""Group the junit report's cases by the reason they failed (W2-170 test design, scratch)."""
import collections
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

tree = ET.parse(sys.argv[1])
groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
passed, skipped = [], []
for case in tree.iter("testcase"):
    name = case.get("name")
    fail = case.find("failure")
    err = case.find("error")
    skip = case.find("skipped")
    if skip is not None:
        skipped.append((name, skip.get("message")))
        continue
    node = fail if fail is not None else err
    if node is None:
        passed.append(name)
        continue
    text = (node.get("message") or "") + "\n" + (node.text or "")
    if "No module named gov.memaudit" in text or "No module named 'gov.memaudit'" in text:
        reason = "gov.memaudit absent"
    elif "UNPLACED" in text:
        reason = "scoped selection: UNPLACED (memaudit not in the test map)"
    else:
        reason = "OTHER: " + re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)[:600]
    groups[reason].append(name)
for reason, names in groups.items():
    print(f"{len(names):4d}  {reason}")
    if reason.startswith("OTHER"):
        for n in names:
            print("        ", n)
print(f"{len(passed):4d}  passed: {passed}")
print(f"{len(skipped):4d}  skipped: {skipped}")
